application_credentials.description:
This integration signs in to YNAB with **your own** OAuth application, so your access token never passes through anyone else's app.

Open [YNAB Developer Settings]({developer_settings_url}) and create a **New Application**:
- **Name:** anything not starting with "YNAB" (YNAB's rule), e.g. "HA Bank Feed Alert for YNAB".
- **Website URL:** https://github.com/dhardiker/ha-bank-feed-alert-for-ynab
- **Privacy Policy URL:** https://github.com/dhardiker/ha-bank-feed-alert-for-ynab/blob/main/PRIVACY.md
- **Redirect URI:** `{redirect_url}` (the only one needed).
- **Default plan selection:** off.

Save it, then copy its **Client ID** and **Client Secret** here. The integration asks YNAB for read-only access; it can never change your plan.

init.title: Alert settings
init.description:
**Escalate after:** how long a bank connection may stay broken before the repair becomes an error and *Reconnect overdue* turns on (0 = straight away).

**Check every:** how often to ask YNAB while all is well. While a connection is broken, and from 2 days before a projected lapse until a day after it, the integration checks every 30 minutes.

**Connection lifetime:** how long your bank connections last before they must be renewed. 90 days is typical for UK and EU banks. Set 0 if yours don't expire on a schedule (most US banks), and nothing will be projected.

reconnect_needed.title: YNAB bank connections need reconnecting ({plan})
reconnect_needed.description:
{count} linked account(s) in **{plan}** have stopped importing because their bank connection needs attention: {accounts}.

Broken since at least {since}. Open YNAB, go to **Manage Bank Connections**, and reconnect each one. This alert clears itself at the next check after they are healthy again.

If they are still broken after {days} day(s), this becomes an error.

reconnect_overdue.title: YNAB bank connections still need reconnecting ({plan})
reconnect_overdue.description:
{count} linked account(s) in **{plan}** have been unable to import since at least {since}: {accounts}.

Transactions are piling up outside YNAB. Open YNAB, go to **Manage Bank Connections**, and reconnect each one now. This alert clears itself at the next check after they are healthy again.

mark_reconnected.name: Mark reconnected
mark_reconnected.description: Tell the integration you renewed a bank connection in YNAB, for example early, or before installing, so its next reconnection can be projected. Target an account's sensor for that account, or the plan's 'Bank feeds need reconnecting' sensor for all of them.

when.description: When you reconnected. Leave empty for now.
